about: Every number the world uses. Nothing is hard-coded in src/. Each row names its source.
tick_source: Frankendom V3 fixed 60 Hz sim (docs/BRIEF.md: standing ragdolls at 60)
velocity_iterations_source: BRIEF: 6 iterations (Gladio steps 6; M1 bake-off used 6)
collision_substeps_source: BRIEF: 120 Hz substep only for thrown weapons and cuts, standing ragdolls at 60. 2 substeps per 60 Hz tick = 120 Hz.
cut_high_rate_ticks_source: own: 2 s of 120 Hz after a cut, so the falling piece does not tunnel; tune on clips

motor.limp_source: M1 adapters.mjs: damper = C x 0.1 x 2 at strength <= 0.01 (approximation of Hellish Quart's damper 2; the unit systems differ)

hinge_flex_z_source: own: which way a positive hinge angle flexes a hinge role, as the sign of the z move (the body faces +z): an elbow flexes forward (+1), a knee backward (-1). Was hard-coded in engine.mjs buildDefinition; a role not listed keeps +1. M9b row.
max_dt_source: own: step(dt) never runs more than 4 fixed ticks per call, so a stalled tab cannot spiral
